items.note: These are the sort of curated, specialist selections that I created 'Back Announce' for in the first place. Fracture throws down an hour of crunchy, experimental bass, jungle and DnB, on the mic the whole time to share deets on what we're listening to.

card.desc: On BBC Sounds until 23 Dec. Jaguar brings you a Dark 'n Dubby selection to test your speakers, featuring music from Arthi, Fork and Knife, India Shan, Luke Gomm & JayaHadADream, CPYRGHT, Timothy B, Javeon, BIGDADDEH & more. Produced by BBC Audio for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
card.title: with Jaguar: Dark 'n Dubby

items.note: An excellent selection of upbeat bass, dubstep and DnB from across the spectrum, a killer source of new bottom-heavy tunes and one of my weekly favourites.

card.desc: On BBC Sounds until 19 Dec. IDK picks his 3 records and Thaksin enters Album Mode. Produced by TBI Media for BBC Radio 1.
card.title: IDK In 3

items.note: I've always loved hip hop, but I've also always found it difficult to keep up with (particularly during the 2010s when there was so much happening). So this show from Benji B is like a beautiful gift. 2hrs of hip hop, future beats and RnB. Benji B curates this weekly show like a consumate professional.

card.desc: Join Jack for CORE as he catches you up on what's been happening in November so far in the heavy music world! Available until 17 Dec. card.title: CORE, 17 Nov

items.note:
I'm a longtime fan of heavy music and still love to dip in occasionally (when I'm not distracted by electronic stuff), so it's a lot of fun to jump into this. 

The standard of the triple j specialist shows is really high! It's the type of radio curation that I used to take for granted growing up.
